# R14e fixtures (synthetic)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/post_de/design_factory.py` (seeded standard-library values; no study data).

- `coabundance_design`: 2 x 30 independent units; three planted modules (F01-F12, F13-F24, F25-F36), each following
  its own latent factor (module 1 shifted in group B), plus 24 independent noise features; `planted_modules()` gives
  the labels. `n_per_group=6` gives the 12-unit cohort that must be refused.
- `write_ppi_snapshot`: synthetic mapping and interaction sources plus preparation manifests, prepared through the
  R07 `resources prepare` rules (kind `ppi`, score type `combined_score`). The genes of F01-F08 form a fully connected
  planted cluster; every other measured gene has six random partners; 30 unmeasured genes also carry edges, so the
  snapshot is larger than the measured universe.
